how.text:
How it behaves

• Four terminal windows type their command when they scroll into view (so phones get it too) and again on hover, with key clicks when sound is on. Only the hovered window's cursor blinks; idle ones show a hollow cursor, like an unfocused terminal.
• Sound is off by default. Clicks and music are browser-made placeholders until the ElevenLabs files exist.
• The tmux bar sticks to the bottom, highlights the section you're in, and each tab jumps to its section.
• The last 5 project cards load only when you scroll near them.
• Read more opens that project's page styled like a Unix manual page (what `man ship` shows in a terminal): j/k scroll, q or Esc closes, focus goes back to the button.
• The footer types ./hire.sh when it comes into view. Clicking email copies the address.
• Reduced motion: no typing, text shows at once.
